# IProxyCreationCallback

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/32c74b4101392888212aa04d9da684c28a4aa416/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/proxies/IProxyCreationCallback.sol)

**Title:** IProxyCreationCallback

<i>

An interface for a contract that implements a callback function to be executed after the creation of a proxy instance.

</i>

## Functions

<a id="proxycreated-safeproxy-address-bytes-uint256"></a>

### proxyCreated

<i>

Function to be called after the creation of a SafeProxy instance.

</i>

```solidity
function proxyCreated(SafeProxy proxy, address _singleton, bytes calldata initializer, uint256 saltNonce) external;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| proxy | `SafeProxy` | The newly created SafeProxy instance. |
| _singleton | `address` | The address of the singleton contract used to create the proxy. |
| initializer | `bytes` | The initializer function call data. |
| saltNonce | `uint256` | The nonce used to generate the salt for the proxy deployment. |
